flagged.title: Power, Energy and Mains Electricity
flagged.reason: The video incorrectly states that UK mains current changes direction 50 times per second instead of 100 times (50 complete cycles), which is an examinable factual error that loses marks in GCSE physics.

mark_affecting.quote: In fact, in the UK, it changes direction 50 times every single second.

flagged.title: Magnetism, Motors and Generators
flagged.reason: F12 teaches that alternating voltage reverses once per revolution rather than every half-turn, which directly loses exam marks.

mark_affecting.quote: the voltage reverses its direction once for every single revolution
